query: Federal Reserve interest rate outlook September 2026

results.content:
Goldman Sachs predicts the Fed will hold the federal funds target range at 3.50%-3.75% through the remainder of 2026, with any rate cuts postponed to 2027. Traders had fully priced a 25 bps Fed rate hike by December as recently as a week earlier, but it has now shifted to January 2027.

At press time, CME FedWatch Tools shows a 30% odds of a 25 bps Fed rate hike in September, with chances of a pause rising to almost 70%. Goldman Sachs sees further room for hawkish bets to unwind. [...] Fed Rate Hike Odds in September
